mapper.select: SELECT id, template_code, template_name, description, subject, content, require_fields, priority, status, create_time, update_time, update_user, create_user, version, remark FROM sys_email_template WHERE template_code = #{templateCode} AND status = 1 AND priority = (SELECT MAX(priority) FROM sys_email_template WHERE template_code = #{templateCode} AND status = 1) LIMIT 1

SELECT id, template_code AS templateCode, template_name AS templateName, description AS description, subject AS subject, priority AS priority, status AS status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, create_user AS createUser, update_user AS updateUser FROM sys_email_template
AND template_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.templateCode}, '%')
AND template_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.templateName}, '%')
AND subject LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.subject}, '%')
AND status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
